title: SFX — item pickup (coin chirp)
_note: Worked SFX example: the classic two-note 'got something' chirp. era 'sfx' + loop:false, one fast pulse voice with an optional octave sparkle on a 2nd pulse. Short blip into a higher held note. Render with a tight tail, e.g.  render --tail 0.05  -> public/assets/audio/sfx/world-pickup-a.mp3. Use as a template; for other effects swap the gesture (see references/sfx-cookbook.md).
